name: Animate! Philadelphia
blurb: GalaxyCon's anime and animation convention at the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center, with voice actors, animation creators and cosplay guests.
notes: The homepage still shows the just-finished edition (October 2-4, 2026), which ended the day before today (2026-10-05), so it falls outside the research window and is left out per the rule for upcoming editions only. No 2027 date is announced anywhere on the site yet: the schedule and floor-plan links still say 'The 2026 schedule/floor map is available now' with no next-year mention. The 2026 edition ran at the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center, 100 Station Avenue, Oaks, PA 19456, which is presumably where it returns to.
